Select PFM_VALD_Page.VALDPageId as "@pageId", PFM_VALD_Page.PageName as "@pageName", PFM_VALD_Page.PageUrl as "@pageUrl", (Select PFM_VALD_Group.VALDGroupId as "@groupId", PFM_VALD_Group.GroupName as "@name", (Select ValidatorId as "validator/@id", 'database' as "validator/@source", CAST(PFM_VALD_Rule.VALDRuleId as varchar(36)) as "validator/@valRuleid", PFM_VALD_Rule.ShowFixFlag as "validator/@showFix" , PFM_VALD_Rule.ShowExplanationFlag as "validator/@showExplanation", PFM_VALD_Rule.ShowIgnoreFlag as "validator/@showIgnore", PFM_VALD_Rule.PageAnchor as "validator/@pageAnchor", vtp.Explanation as "validator/@explanation", vtp.StatusCode as "validator/@status", PFM_VALD_Rule.ValidationXML as "validator" FROM PFM_VALD_Rule INNER JOIN PFM_VALD_Rule_PFM_VALD_Group_R ON PFM_VALD_Rule_PFM_VALD_Group_R.VALDRuleId = PFM_VALD_Rule.VALDRuleId -- for Explanation LEFT OUTER JOIN PFM_VALD_Transaction_P vtp on ( vtp.VALDRuleId = PFM_VALD_Rule.VALDRuleId and vtp.VALDGroupId = PFM_VALD_Group.VALDGroupId and vtp.VALDPageId=PFM_VALD_Page.VALDPageId and vtp.ResourceValue = and vtp.ResourceType = ) Where PFM_VALD_Rule_PFM_VALD_Group_R.VALDGroupId=PFM_VALD_Group.VALDGroupId AND PFM_VALD_Rule.VALDRuleId in (Select VALDRuleId from #TempValidations) FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ) from PFM_VALD_Group INNER JOIN PFM_VALD_Page_PFM_VALD_Group_R ON PFM_VALD_Group.VALDGroupId = PFM_VALD_Page_PFM_VALD_Group_R.VALDGroupId WHERE PFM_VALD_Page_PFM_VALD_Group_R.VALDPageId = PFM_VALD_Page.VALDPageId AND PFM_VALD_Group.VALDGroupId in (Select VALDGroupId from #TempValidations) FOR XML PATH('group'), TYPE) FROM PFM_VALD_Page WHERE PFM_VALD_Page.VALDPageId in (Select VALDPageId from #TempValidations) FOR XML PATH('validation')
DROP TABLE #TempValidations
